description: Access checks for the owner's door, lift and stairs tour (tools/venue-proposals.py tour-stops writes them, with every door override, into tools/probes/access_stops.json and .lua). Each item is one checkbox. Lifts and floors come from the lift floor audit of 2026-11-27 (lifts the policy has to switch on, lifts the audit could not read, and floors behind a keycard or unsettled); routes are open questions from the sweep triage. Remove an item once the owner confirms it.

items.check: Open the upstairs authorization door from both sides.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; the authorization override needs a re-check.

items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; the authorization override needs a re-check.

items.check: Inspect both sides of the five locked floor-33 office and secret-room doors; log look-ats and identify whether rooms are built and reachable.

items.check: Ride the real floor-33 lift to the atrium and back; record the offered floors and log look-ats on its actual doors and terminals.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: lift rule 13; the reported adjacent terminals are fake, and the round trip failed.

items.check: Try the glass double door and its available quickhack from both sides; log a look-at if access still fails.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; policy kept the lock because another way in was present.

items.check: Inspect the green double door from both sides and log a look-at while it fails to offer interaction.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; it logged open and unlocked despite no interaction.

items.check: Inspect the window blinders and try their control or quickhack; log a look-at on the control if they remain closed.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; the WindowBlinders device is outside door override handling.

items.check: At both garage doors, log look-ats on their controls and identify whether each surface is a static shutter or an operable device.
items.why: Owner tour 2026-11-27: access rule 24; both look-ats hit static geometry and the garage devices are not yet identified.
